title: The 1500s Colony Where Everyone Went Blind After 3 Years
hook: A Spanish settlement in South America where every single colonist mysteriously lost their sight—and the truth was deliberately hidden for centuries.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visceral hook of sudden blindness combined with a cover-up triggers extreme curiosity and shareability.

title: The Forgotten 1740s Massacre Where Victims Were Fed to Crocodiles

why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme animal-related death and colonial erasure create a shocking, unforgettable narrative.

title: The 1798 Law That Made It Illegal to Cry in Public
